paragraphs.text: Pitdown was one of the twelve Southern City-States during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Pitdown was situated on the eastern coast of Terisiare between the neighboring city-states of Alsoor and Ghed , near the Alamar River . During the Battle of Pitdown , the armies of Alsoor and Ghed met in a three-way battle with goblin raiders, and many people died.
After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the Bone Flute out of Lord Ursnell’s left leg.

Fleeing the battle, Jodah came to the deserted city and stumbled across a Fountain of Youth in the city square. The Fountain of Youth was situated in the middle of the city square, though none save the pigeons knew its secret. The fountain had lions' head statues that poured the water into the basin and had once held a grand look, but it was poorly tended, and the waters were covered with dirt, algae, and various weeds. Forced to hide in the fountain from a band of goblin raiders, Jodah accidentally drank some of its water. While he did notice that his leg wound had healed afterward, he did not ascribe this to the fountain at the time. He realized this much later when he wasn't aging like his cohort.
